_about: PROTOTYPE (overnight run). Synthetic Corals' Sheet variants; see .scratch/v1-launch/overnight/TOOLS.md. Ids CA–CC (not A–C: those are shared bodies, TOOLS.md §1).

CA.name: Plate: four runs round the short clip on one black plate with a legend (run 3 an empty line), settings as a node canvas, the long clip on white with label cards

CB.name: Re-roll: one frame you run again through the runs, the settings as a printed ticket, a lights switch from bleached to glowing

CC.name: Spectrum: a run bento, each run as a colour-share bar, a drag turntable of the clip, the prompt as tagged tokens

CD.name: Plate, refined: CA with the preview at the plate's centre, white node wires with one red on hover, the 5 s clip once beside six frames of the 10 s clip

CE.name: Latent map: the four runs plotted on a bleached-to-glowing, rock-to-polyp field with a big readout, the prompt as a photo caption with an EXIF bar, the clip beside the preview

CF.name: Lots: the runs as auction lots (lot 3 struck) with a sticky viewer, the prompt as a catalogue note with a ruled spec, the clip as a detail
